cohort: All patients undergoing emergency laparotomy, elective and emergency inguinal hernia repair, elective and emergency caesarean section, amputation, fracture manipulation, or fracture fixation over a 3-month period in a single district African hospital.
finding: Surgery is a highly cost-effective healthcare measure in an African district hospital, with an overall cost-effectiveness of $10.70 per DALY averted.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean section was found to be highly cost-effective at $7.42 per DALY averted, while elective caesarean section was $20.50 per DALY averted.
